Chapter 812: Chapter 19 What Can You Do To Me? _2

Chapter 812: Chapter 19 What Can You Do to Me? _2

—

To know, the Demonic Divine Masters at the Ninth Stage, though all exceedingly wise, still inherently revered strength due to their evil deity nature.

In such a case, the higher the status of the Tianzhi True Lord, the more extraordinary this Perfect Demon True Lord must be.

…

Billions of miles away from where Lin Yuan was.

On an ordinary hill stood a figure.

...

This figure was a mere ten meters tall, with a head nearly the size of its body, unlike other evil gods, it had not a trace of malevolence, its eyes tranquil.

This figure was none other than the Tianzhi True Lord. An anomaly amongst the many evil gods, renowned for wisdom.

“Tianzhi.”

“I’ve already convinced the Taiyang Divine Master.”

“The Taiyang Divine Master has also agreed to come to our aid when necessary.”

Just then, the Eastern Wing Lord approached quickly, standing below the Tianzhi True Lord, and spoke up.

In fact, it wasn’t just the Taiyang Divine Master who was a Perfect Divine Master. On their way here, under the direction of the Tianzhi True Lord, the Eastern Wing Lord had visited several Perfect Demon True Lords.

Looking across the entire Boundless Void, there were no more than a hundred Perfect Demon True Lords. Which of them wasn’t dominant in their own realm? Other Perfect Demons would have a hard time finding them even if they wanted to.

Only the Tianzhi True Lord could know the whereabouts of most of them through peeking deductions.

“This Taiyang Divine Master has a great secret. In the Boundless Void for tens of millions of years, there have been no traces left by this divine master,” said the Tianzhi True Lord, frowning slightly.

“Great secret?”

The Eastern Wing Lord said nonchalantly: “Which one of us Perfect Divine Masters doesn’t have a great secret? As long as it doesn’t threaten the Boundless Void, it’s fine.”

Evil gods were solitary, especially the Perfect Demon True Lords who evolved to the Ninth Stage. They almost all harbored great secrets.

Even the Eastern Wing Lord was aware that a few of the Perfect Demon True Lords did not grow up in the Boundless Void.

They came from the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, a region that only the creators of the Void Secret Realm could enter, filled with numerous Void Creatures.

Over the long years, occasional rifts would appear in that space, allowing some weaker evil gods to fall in, with a great chance of evolving into Perfect Demon True Lords before making their way out.

Tianzhi True Lord also couldn’t detect any traces left by those few Perfect Demon True Lords.

“That’s true.”

Tianzhi True Lord nodded.

After all, the Boundless Void still had too many secrets unfathomed, with the Void Secret Realm being just one of them.

As long as the Taiyang Divine Master didn’t do what the Taiyin Sovereign did, nurturing those foods, Tianzhi True Lord couldn’t be bothered to intervene.

“Tianzhi, isn’t it enough to confront the Taiyin Sovereign with the thirteen Perfect Divine Masters we have convinced?” The Eastern Wing Lord couldn’t help but speak out.

Before visiting Lin Yuan, the Eastern Wing Lord had already visited twelve Perfect Demon True Lords.

Adding themselves, there were fifteen Perfect Demon True Lords in total.

“Mm, it should be enough.”

Tianzhi True Lord nodded slightly, giving the Eastern Wing Lord a glance, “The strength of the Taiyin Sovereign is above yours, to suppress without any risks, fear that we would need more than ten Perfect Demon True Lords.”

Among the Perfect Evil Gods, there were levels to their abilities, winners and losers in their strength.

Defeating is easy, but killing is as hard as ascending to heaven.

Even for an ordinary Perfect Divine Master, suppression might require five or six of the same rank.

The strength of the Taiyin Sovereign was somewhat stronger than ordinary Perfect Divine Masters, mobilizing ten of the same rank would be considered foolproof.

“I understand.”

The Eastern Wing Lord immediately nodded.

In fact, according to the Eastern Wing Lord’s estimate, no matter how strong the Taiyin Sovereign was, it shouldn’t exceed the Ninth Stage by much. As long as it wasn’t the Tenth Stage, seven or eight of the same rank would probably suffice.

But seven or eight Perfect Divine Masters attempting to suppress the Taiyin Sovereign could lead to accidents.

For instance, during the Taiyin Sovereign’s resistance, two or three Perfect Divine Masters might get injured.

Under such circumstances, naturally the more Perfect Divine Masters, the better.

After all, this was for the entire Boundless Void, and it didn’t require the Eastern Wing Lord to pay any price.

“However, both this Taiyang Divine Master and the Taiyin Sovereign have appeared within a thousand years?” Tianzhi True Lord’s eyes revealed a trace of doubt.

If not for the opposite powers wielded by the Taiyang Divine Master and the Taiyin Sovereign, and the fact that one was in the Void Secret Realm while the other was in the Boundless Void with even their actions distinctly different,

Tianzhi True Lord would have even suspected any relation between the two.

“This must be a coincidence.” The Eastern Wing Lord speculated: “Although we evil gods can create incarnations, the power of the incarnation shares the same origin as the principal self and is much weaker.”

“The difference between this Taiyang Divine Master and the Taiyin Sovereign… is very clear.”

The Eastern Wing Lord spoke.

The many abilities held by evil gods were indeed unfathomable, but also had to abide by the laws of the cosmos, of which the Eastern Wing Lord and Tianzhi True Lord were very aware.

“Let’s see when the time comes.”

Tianzhi True Lord’s eyes flashed. In fact, he had tasked the Eastern Wing Lord with the specific duty of inviting the Taiyang Divine Master this time to test whether there was any real connection between the two.

According to the Eastern Wing Lord’s description, the Taiyang Divine Master did not show any abnormalities, but the Tianzhi True Lord still had not let down his guard.

As the Perfect Demon True Lord known for ‘wisdom,’ Tianzhi True Lord would not easily trust anything. If the Taiyang Divine Master did not reveal any flaws now, Tianzhi True Lord didn’t mind continuing to wait.

Five hundred years? A thousand? Ten thousand? Or even longer?
